claude.result:
Done. `game.html` (143 KB, single self-contained file) is written to the working directory.

**What's in it**

| System | Implementation |
|---|---|
| Core loop | One `S` state object, serialisable mulberry32 cursor (seed 1337, editable), fixed 10-step turn order documented in the source header, the Log tab, and the Dev panel |
| Map | 8×8 seeded terrain (ash/rock/water/vent/ruins) with guaranteed feature minimums; 13 buildings with terrain gates and adjacency bonuses shown in the build tooltip *before* you commit |
| Economy | 9 resources; real chains — ash→soil (composter) →food (greenhouse, drinks water), ore+power→metal (forge), metal+power→parts (workshop); caps with logged overflow |
| People | Named colonists, 4 jobs, skill 1–5 growing only on matching work, fatigue, morale; output = skill × job-match × fatigue × morale, each factor itemised in tooltips |
| Needs | 1.0 food / 1.2 water per head per turn; shortages tank morale; at 0 they refuse work, at 3 consecutive zero turns they leave — recoverable |
| Research | 12 nodes, prereq-gated, locked/available/done, unlocking buildings and measurably changing yields and storm damage |
| Events | 14 events, weighted deck with cooldowns, 6 offering three genuinely divergent choices (the choice modal blocks End Turn) |
| Trade | Caravan with limited stock *and* limited scrip; price = base × drifting global index × your own scarcity, with Trade Charter/Post margins |
| Hazard | Ashstorm every 6 turns (severity scales with turn), building damage → 0.55× then OFFLINE below 40 hp, water surge, baffles shield adjacent tiles, repairs cost parts + a rested colonist's labour |
| Save/Load | JSON in a textarea, validated with specific errors (bad JSON, missing field, wrong version, 63 tiles, negative resource, phantom assignment) |
| End | Turn 60 win at pop ≥12 with stores/morale intact; loss at pop 0; scored summary with per-line breakdown |
| Dev | 29 assertions and a 200-turn deterministic benchmark printing a state hash twice |

**Verification caveat, stated plainly:** this sandbox denied every attempt to execute JavaScript (`node -e`, `node file.js`, `python3 -c` all came back "requires approval"), so I could not run the suite myself — I reviewed the code by hand instead. That review turned up and fixed a real invariant bug: events and choice outcomes hand out goods *after* step 4's cap check, so a turn could end above a storage cap. `applyCaps` now also runs at the end of `endTurn`, after `resolveChoice`, and after `demolish` salvage. I also made the benchmark's greedy policy crew buildings round-robin rather than filling one type at a time, which was leaving the composter unmanned and starving the food chain.

Open the file and hit **Run Tests** in the Dev tab — that's the check I couldn't run for you.
